name: @intellectual-frontiers/integrations
description: Integrations in the layers of Kanon: connectors that observe the outside world read-only (clouds, SaaS, identity, code hosts, HR, endpoints, network devices) and exchanges of messages and documents under standards and partner agreements (FHIR, X12, HL7 v2), with each standard a plugin package behind typed ports and a conformance suite.

scripts.verify: tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun ../tools/mizan-check.ts --root spec-kit && bun ../libraries/src/check.ts --root spec-kit --level L1 && bun ../kanon/src/check.ts && bun tools/check.ts && bun test suite/ && bun tools/pack.ts --check
